pageData.heading: Smart Income Strategies for a Secure Retirement
pageData.para: Retirement should be about peace of mind, not financial stress. The right investment mix ensures steady income, safety, and liquidity. Here’s a breakdown of the best low-risk, income-generating options tailored for retirees.

National Pension System (NPS): Long-term retirement corpus with tax benefits

Bank Fixed Deposits (FDs): Retirees looking for safe & predictable returns

FD Laddering Strategy: Varies based on tenure, balances risk & returns
Payouts depend on deposit maturity schedule

Safe Fixed-Income Options: Those seeking stable income with flexibility

Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP): No fixed lock-in, but exit load may apply
Retirees needing regular withdrawals with tax benefits

Dividend Stocks & REITs: No fixed lock-in, but long-term holding recommended
Passive income seekers through dividends & real estate

Index Funds for Retirement Growth: No lock-in, ideal for long-term investment
Long-term investors looking for capital appreciation

Annuity Plans: Retirees seeking a fixed pension for life

Immediate & Deferred Annuities: Fixed payouts based on annuity type
Retirees choosing between immediate or future payouts
